scope: Incremental direct-phone LAN access to the existing private dashboard
baseline: The base dashboard's four-persona documentation audit remains in 2026-11-03-dashboard.json. This increment carries it forward and includes the changed phone/TLS instructions in focused independent spec and quality passes; it does not claim four new persona reviews.

review.spec: PASS, tier-1 direct-phone LAN satisfaction96/100;27 secret-free policy checks
review.quality: PASS; focused HTTPS/localhost regressions, profile policy, discovery and real-socket source-ACL-before-TLS counterfactual

actions.finding: The initial localhost-only access assumption required SSH and did not match the operator's explicit phone-on-LAN workflow.
actions.remedy: Add an optional shared HTTPS profile for server and private-link generation, explicit RFC1918 bind and client CIDRs, and bounded-worker TLS. Preserve localhost defaults and existing token/read-only protections.

actions.finding: A self-signed local certificate is not automatically trusted by a phone.
actions.remedy: Verify the certificate fingerprint against the server before trusting it, or use a certificate the phone already trusts. The application still requires the private token.

actions.finding: A DHCP address can change and a guest/isolated Wi-Fi network may not reach the server LAN.
actions.remedy: Use the same allowed LAN and reserve the address when a stable bookmark is needed; do not widen the bind or disable network gates as a fallback.

evidence.default_behavior: All original localhost, authentication, source and UI regressions preserved
evidence.real_tls_fixture: Trusted certificate;401/200/403; client-CIDR denial; held raw handshake does not block another valid client
evidence.configuration: Missing TLS, bad pairs/types/keys, wildcard/public addresses, missing/public client CIDRs and unknown settings rejected
evidence.live_endpoint: Existing enabled user service listens on only the selected real LAN IPv4 address; native CA/IP verification and authentication/Host/Origin checks pass
evidence.browser: Actual LAN HTTPS origin, explicit matching SPKI pin, desktop and390px mobile, removed token fragment, live metrics/services/filtering and offline recovery
evidence.secrets: Key, certificate, profile and token remain outside Git; existing token and OS permissions unchanged
evidence.ruggedness: One current RUGGED review with field rungs4/5

limits: No physical phone or independent LAN device was available; real server LAN and phone-sized browser results are not a physical-device claim.
Local certificate trust and DHCP stability remain operator/environment concerns.
No router, global firewall, group, container-daemon or cleanup-job changes.
The four unrelated pre-existing strict documentation-site link warnings remain outside this increment.
